I visited KISOM Atelier on one of their opening days — and what an experience it was! From the moment you step inside, you’re struck by the stunning interior: exquisite décor, stylish furniture, gorgeous crockery, and thoughtful touches everywhere, from the elegant cups and saucers to lush plants and even a super cool faucet in the bathroom. The neutral tones make the whole place feel calm and inviting, and there are books galore to browse. Authentic Japanese crockery lines the shelves, adding to the charm 🤩 The warm, friendly staff greeted me with a lovely welcome, setting the tone for the rest of my visit. And the best part? The menu! It’s packed with delicious drinks — top-quality matcha, smooth coffee, and even hojicha — plus an irresistible selection of cakes and cookies Overall, it’s a solid 10/10. Such a groovy spot — I’ll definitely be back and I highly recommend you check it out too. You’ll probably see me there! I'm in love 🥰
